title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: WEATHERED LONGSWORD
effect: A well-maintained longsword with a comfortable grip. A fighter gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls with this weapon for one encounter.
lore: This blade has seen many battles. The leather grip is worn but sturdy, someone loved this weapon once. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + 2 slashing damage, or 1d10 + 2 slashing damage if used with two hands. A natural 1 will destroy this weapon.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: STURDY DAGGER
effect: A practical dagger with a sharp edge. A rogue gains advantage on one attack roll per battle made with this weapon.
lore: Small, efficient, and deadly—exactly as its maker intended. This dagger has been sharpened a thousand times, yet the blade refuses to dull. Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4 + 3 piercing damage.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: WOODEN BOW
effect: A reasonably well-crafted bow with a bundle of 20 arrows. Grants +1 to damage rolls with ranged attacks for the next three encounters.
lore: The wood is light and supple. The string is taut and true. Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 3 piercing damage.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: CRACKED STAFF
effect: A staff of darkwood with a visible crack running down its length. A wizard may add one dice to the damage roll before the staff crumbles to dust.
lore: This staff once channeled immense magical power. The crack suggests it was pushed beyond its limits—perhaps in a desperate battle, or a final act of defiance.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: BLESSED HOLY SYMBOL
effect: A silver holy symbol of exceptional craftsmanship. A cleric gains advantage on the next Healing Word or cure spell they cast.
lore: Worn smooth by generations of prayers, this symbol radiates quiet faith. It has been pressed to foreheads in blessing, clutched in fear, and offered in sacrifice.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: SEALED BARREL OF SALTED BEEF
effect: A large sealed barrel containing preserved beef. Restore the Meal Meter by 2 points. The party gains +1 to Constitution saves for one floor due to hearty nutrition.
lore: The salt preserves everything—meat, memory, hope. This barrel has survived the dungeon's decay. Whoever packed it knew their craft.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: SACK OF GRAIN
effect: A sturdy burlap sack filled with dried grain and flour. Restore the Meal Meter by 1 point or use in a meal. The grain can be ground and cooked into a simple but filling meal.
lore: Golden and clean, untouched by mold or rot. This sack represents survival itself—the most basic, most essential resource in any dungeon.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: WHEELS OF HARD CHEESE
effect: Three wheels of aged cheese, wrapped in cloth. Restore the Meal Meter by 2 points or use in a meal. The cheese's sharp flavor grants advantage on the next Charisma check.
lore: The cheese has aged to perfection in this cool, dark place. Its complexity suggests years of careful aging. Eating it feels like tasting history.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: HEALING DRAUGHT
effect: A vial of shimmering blue potion. When consumed, the drinker regains 2d6 + 2 hit points. Can be used once.
lore: The liquid catches the light strangely. Smells a bit like honey, but certainly doesn't taste like it.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: ROPE AND GRAPPLING HOOK
effect: 50 feet of high-quality rope and a sturdy grappling hook. The party gains advantage on the next Athletics or Acrobatics check involving climbing or swinging.
lore: The rope is new, well-maintained, and coiled with expert care. It has never been used. Perhaps it was meant for this very moment.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: MAP FRAGMENT
effect: An old, water-stained map showing part of the dungeon's layout. The party may re-roll one failed Navigation or Investigation check on the current floor.
lore: The parchment is yellowed but legible. It shows passages and chambers long forgotten. Someone mapped this place before and left clues for those who came after.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: CELEBRATORY WINE
effect: A bottle of exceptionally fine wine, marked with an ancient vintage. When consumed as a group, the entire party's morale improves. Restore the Meal Meter by 3 points and grant advantage on the next social check.
lore: The label is faded but the wine is perfect. Drinking it feels like a small defiance.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: GOLDEN IDOL (SMALL)
effect: A small golden statuette, finely crafted. It has no magical properties but is worth 150 gold pieces to any merchant. The party may sell it for supplies.
lore: The gold is pure and the craftsmanship exquisite. It was clearly treasured once. Now it sits here, waiting for someone new to claim it.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: MYSTERIOUS HERB BUNDLE
effect: A bundle of dried herbs tied with cord. When brewed into tea and consumed by the entire party, restore the Meal Meter by 1 point and grant resistance to poison damage for one floor.
lore: The herbs smell strange and wonderful. Their origin is a mystery, but their effect is undeniable. Perhaps they grew in some forgotten corner of the dungeon.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD (TRAP)
name: POISON GAS TRAP
effect: As you open the chest, noxious purple gas erupts. Each party member must make a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, they take 2d6 poison damage and are poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, they take half damage and aren't poisoned.
lore: The chest was a trap all along. Someone or something, filled it with deadly gas to punish the unwary.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD (TRAP)
name: EXPLOSIVE RUNES
effect: The chest is inscribed with magical runes that trigger when opened. Each party member within 10 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
lore: Arcane symbols cover the inside of the chest, glowing faintly. The lunatic magician's trap for the unwary.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD (CURSE)
name: CURSED AMULET
effect: A beautiful amulet lies within. Any creature who picks it up must make a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, they are cursed and have disadvantage on all saving throws for the next floor. The curse can be removed with Remove Curse or similar magic.
lore: The amulet is gorgeous—almost hypnotic. But something about it feels wrong. The craftsmanship is perfect, but the intent behind it is twisted.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: RESURRECTION FLOWER
effect: A single flower with luminous petals, preserved perfectly. If a party member dies before the end of the next dungeon floor, this flower can be used to restore them to 1 hit point. It crumbles to dust after use.
lore: The flower shouldn't exist in a place like this. Yet it thrives, perfect and beautiful. It feels like a gift from something ancient and kind.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: ENCHANTED LANTERN
effect: A brass lantern that burns with a cold, blue flame. It sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius. While lit, all party members gain advantage on Perception checks to spot hidden creatures or objects.
lore: The flame burns without fuel, eternally. Those who pass through its light seem to see things others miss. This lantern was crafted by someone who valued truth above all else.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: DUNGEON GOURMET GUIDE
effect: A leather-bound journal filled with notes from a previous adventurer. Reading it grants the party advantage on the next Wisdom (Insight) check and reveals one useful piece of information about dungeon hazards.
lore: Page after page is filled with careful handwritten observations, warnings, stories and even recipes. Somehow you don't feel like all of it's quite as accurate as your originally thought.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: KENSUKE
effect: A sword taken from a defeated Living Armor. It seems to be infested by a helpful colony of Living Armor that now considers it your kin. Wielding it provides +3 on initiative rolls, and the player cannot be ambushed or surprised.
lore: The sword's inhabitant, aptly named Kensuke, seems to be able to sense monsters. A soft rattling sound only the wielder can hear is heard when enemies are nearby.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: ELEMENTAL CONTAINER
effect: Summon the undine Marillier (AC 15, HP 22, Speed 30ft). Can cast Water Jet once per turn (ranged spell attack +4, 2d6 cold damage, 60ft range). Lasts until destroyed or dismissed.
lore: A small container holding the undine Marillier. Attached are instructions for care, bonding and commands. Seems the previous caretaker loved these spirits very much.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: SCROLL OF WATER WALK
effect: A scroll that teaches your mage or cleric the spell Water Walk. This spell allows (as ritual) up to 5 willing creatures to walk on water for 1 floor. Spell is cancelled if caster dies.
lore: Rumor has it that this spell was once used on an aquatic monster to force it to surface. It's normally used to cross water safely, though.

title: TREASURE CHEST REWARD CARD
name: TELEPORTATION TOME
effect: A tome containing the secrets of advanced teleportation magic. Once per floor, the reader can teleport an adjacent enemy (within 5 feet) to any visible location.
lore: The most powerful captain of the Canaries uses magic much like this offensively, teleporting foes into walls and objects. Even teleporting objects through enemies to slice them apart.
